Initial release of Google AI Studio — Generate and Edit AI Videos.

- Enables AI-powered video summarization and highlight generation using Google Gemini AI.
- Supports uploading up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI formats for server-side processing.
- Automatic session and token management with easy cloud setup.
- Simple prompts for tasks like editing, summarizing, or exporting video.
- Fast turnaround: get processed video results within 30–90 seconds.
- Includes quick balance checks, export actions, and detailed session status.
